notes: «قراءة عليه وأنا أسمع» and «- واللفظ له -» are the compiler's notes and are left out
«ابنى عبد الله بن عمر» describes حمزة and سالم and is not a link
مالك is written twice: once beside الحارث بن مسكين before ابن القاسم, and again after him (not consecutive, so two links)
The last link is Abd Allah b. Umar, the Companion whose words the Prophet's saying is
